svg.aria-label: One version for the setup: VERSION holds the semver, overdrive.lock pins components by SHA, and every version keeps its own log. Drift on session start: A SessionStart hook checks the pins in under 150 ms and records drift in the background. Colored tool rows: INF cyan for reads, CHG magenta for changes, RUN yellow for shell and agents. Click a tag to fold or open the row. Tab band: Code, tickets, Claude usage, overdrive state and a serpent pet, in a pink box above the prompt. Session log: Every tool appends INFO, WARN and CRITICAL lines to one crash-safe log per Claude session. Trace: overdrive trace reads a finished session: tool calls, wall time and token counts per tool
